entity.description: A write of the dev-aide: a save, create, move, delete, or a git command that writes, with who, where, the file's hashes before and after, and a JSON detail.

field.name: actionEnumId
field.description: DAA_SAVE, DAA_CREATE, DAA_MOVE, DAA_DELETE, DAA_GIT, DAA_DDL, DAA_LOAD, DAA_TRY

field.name: agentRunId
field.description: When an agent proposed the write

entity.description: A root added in Settings, or the settings of a discovered one, by its location.

field.name: publishBranch
field.description: Publish pushes here: a name or a pattern with {user} (question 15).

field.name: hostedServerId
field.description: The group server (DevAideServer) that hosts the repository of this working tree's remote (plans/design-dev-aide.md 21.3), asked when it is resolved and on a fetch

field.name: hostedRemote
field.description: The remote whose URL it is behind

field.name: hostedJson
field.description: What the server answered of the repository: its path, default branch, the user's rights, its merge request settings, who keeps it, the agreement

entity.description: An instance-wide setting Settings stores over the conf: siteComponents (a comma list), networkGit (Y on a shared server whose admin enabled the network commands).

A connection to a group server (plans/design-dev-aide.md 21.2, D20): its address, what it offers (asked of it: /rest/s1/moqui/hosting/offer), the user's account there, and what Connect set from it, so Remove takes it back. The token is the DevAideCredential of the same serverId. A user's own; with no userId an admin's for the instance (a shared server's deploy connection).

field.name: username
field.description: The account on the server, as it answered

field.name: statusText
field.description: reachable, unreachable, connected (the token is good), signed-out (the token is not)

field.name: setupJson
field.description: What Connect set: the myaddons.xml repository, the task source and app, the .env lines, the git credential

field.name: pendingState
field.description: An installed-app sign-in under way (F17): its state, PKCE verifier and redirect URI, good for 15 minutes

entity.description: Shared mode (D19): a deploy token for a root's remote, or a user's HTTPS token, set by an admin; and a group server's login key (serverId), sent only to that server's address (urlPrefix).

field.name: serverId
field.description: A group server's token: its REST and, with useForGit, git over HTTPS to its host

field.name: useForGit
field.description: Y: git gets this server token for the server's host in place of git's own credential helpers (Connect's choice)

field.name: userId
field.description: Empty for the root's deploy token

field.name: urlPrefix
field.description: The scheme, host and port the token is for (https://git.example.com): git gets it for that remote only

entity.description: A user's task source (plans/design-dev-aide.md 14): another Moqui instance, such as the team's Projects server, read over its REST API with the user's own access token. This instance's Mantle tasks need no row.

field.name: projectFilter
field.description: Project ids, comma separated; empty for every project

field.name: serverId
field.description: Made by Connect for a group server: its token is the server's credential, and token here is empty

field.name: tasksPath
field.description: The REST path of the user's tasks, as the server offers it; Mantle's /rest/s1/mantle/my/tasks when empty

entity.description: A task app added in Settings, as the conf's task-app: the paths that open a project, a task and a new task, with {projectId} and {taskId}, and a base URL when it is another instance.
